text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф's dreams have been
dashed, but
she won't give up. Her
sights stay firmly fixed on
the future.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She resolves to prove her worth in the
Kikuka
Sho, but her packed schedule is
starting to take
its toll, and Эйр Грув
is only getting more
concerned.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As usual, however, it's Симболи Рудольф's
way or
the highway. Even a grueling race
can't keep her
from her student council
duties.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
